document_title: POLARIS STAGE 8 NUMERICAL PROVENANCE FIREWALL SPECIFICATION

G1_persist_row_level_predictions.name: Persist Row-Level Predictions
G1_persist_row_level_predictions.requirement: Exactly one authoritative prediction row per origin x horizon (e.g. 173 ODD origins x 24 horizons = 4,152 rows).

G2_persist_actual_target.name: Persist Actual Target Alongside Prediction
G2_persist_actual_target.requirement: Mandatory columns: origin_datetime, horizon_hour, target_timestamp, y_true, y_pred.

G3_persist_artifact_hash.name: Persist Prediction Artifact Hash
G3_persist_artifact_hash.requirement: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of prediction table persisted in evaluation manifest.

G4_recompute_metrics_from_rows.name: Direct Metric Recomputation
G4_recompute_metrics_from_rows.requirement: Recompute MAE, nMAE, RMSE, bias directly from persisted rows. Zero hardcoded metric literals.

G5_recompute_control_metric.name: Independent Control Baseline Recomputation
G5_recompute_control_metric.requirement: Independently recompute control metric from same evaluation artifact.

G6_control_tolerance_stop_gate.name: Hard Control Tolerance Stop Gate
G6_control_tolerance_stop_gate.requirement: If actual control != frozen reference control within exact tolerance (|delta| <= 1e-5 W/m2): STOP. No editing evaluator literals. No hardcoding expected metrics. No promotion.

G7_prohibit_evaluator_literals.name: Prohibition of Manual Evaluator Literals
G7_prohibit_evaluator_literals.requirement: Metrics must NEVER be inserted manually into evaluation code to make assertions pass.

G8_classify_synthetic_sources.name: Synthetic Data Source Classification
G8_classify_synthetic_sources.requirement: Any synthetic feature/data source must be explicitly classified SYNTHETIC and can never qualify as real-world evidence for an operational promotion.

G9_recomputable_bootstrap_bounds.name: Recomputable Bootstrap Results
G9_recomputable_bootstrap_bounds.requirement: Bootstrap results must be recomputable from persisted row-level predictions.

G10_end_to_end_numerical_lineage.name: Complete End-to-End Numerical Lineage
G10_end_to_end_numerical_lineage.requirement: Promotion is forbidden unless numerical provenance is complete from raw input artifact -> feature artifact -> frozen model/config -> row-level predictions -> independently recomputed metrics.
